ck_activities_parent.name: ck_activities_parent
ck_activities_parent.value: "activities"."lead_id" is not null or "activities"."opportunity_id" is not null or "activities"."contact_id" is not null

uq_companies_ruc.name: uq_companies_ruc
uq_companies_ruc.where: "companies"."ruc" is not null and "companies"."deleted_at" is null

uq_contacts_email.name: uq_contacts_email
uq_contacts_email.where: "contacts"."email" is not null and "contacts"."deleted_at" is null

ck_leads_reach.name: ck_leads_reach
ck_leads_reach.value: "leads"."email" is not null or "leads"."phone" is not null

ck_leads_public_consent.name: ck_leads_public_consent
ck_leads_public_consent.value: "leads"."source" not in ('web_form','landing') or "leads"."consent_at" is not null

uq_opportunities_lead.name: uq_opportunities_lead
uq_opportunities_lead.where: "opportunities"."lead_id" is not null and "opportunities"."deleted_at" is null
